note: Round 2 of the FID loop (user, 2026-10-10): self-teaching with the model as its own judge (job cfg selfteach), 20-minute cycles, equal compute. Every run starts from the baseline checkpoint with base_change. A node trains base_steps / cost steps. change = patch of the job config. pass = next node if the FID beats the reference by more than the margin (the change is kept), fail = next node if not (the change is dropped). follower_only = runs only when another node names it. No node adds a model parameter.

st_z6.why: Self-teaching, z after block 6: crops of the output image and of the noised image are pulled to the clean crop in the model's own hidden state

st_z6_w2.why: Both self-teaching terms at weight 2, on top of the gain at weight 1

st_z6_out_only.why: Self-teaching at block 6 with the output term only (no noised pass, more steps), after both terms together failed

st_z6_noised_only.why: Self-teaching at block 6 with the noised term only (no output pass), after the output term failed

st_z6_tenth.why: Self-teaching at block 6 with both terms at weight 0.1: a light pull

st_z3.why: Self-teaching at block 3, repeated on the Spark: on the 3090 it gave 123.09 against 124.57 with 10,000 steps in place of 16,000

st_z3_w2.why: Both self-teaching terms at weight 2, on top of the gain at block 3

st_z2.why: Self-teaching at block 2: a shallower and cheaper judge than block 3, so more steps in the cycle

st_out_w2.why: Output term of self-teaching at weight 2 in place of 1

st_out_w4.why: Output term at weight 4, on top of the gain at weight 2

st_out_half.why: Output term at weight 0.5, after weight 2 failed

st_mild_crop.why: Larger crops for the judge: 0.5 to 1.0 of the side in place of 0.2 to 0.9

st_small_crop.why: Smaller crops for the judge: 0.1 to 0.5 of the side, after the larger crops failed

st_no_selfflow_teacher.why: Is the self-flow teaching term still needed beside self-teaching? Teacher pass off (mixed noise stays), its compute goes to more steps

st_flow_w2.why: Self-flow teaching term at weight 2: the second winner of the 3090 loop (115.39 against 116.91), repeated on the Spark with block 6

st_flow_w4.why: Self-flow teaching term at weight 4 (114.38 on the 3090, 1.0 better than weight 2 but under the margin)

st_flow_w8.why: Self-flow teaching term at weight 8, after weight 4 gained

st_z3_base.why: Block 3 again (116.55 against 116.08 before): the cheaper judge, the one of the 200,000-step run

st_share40.why: 40% of the student patches at the higher noise level (level with 25% on the 3090)

st_teach_noisy.why: The self-flow teaching term counts only the noisier patches, beside self-teaching

st_tiny_crop.why: Crops of 0.05 to 0.3 of the side (0.1 to 0.5 was level here and 1 FID better on the 3090, twice)

st_inside_crop.why: Crops stay inside the image (overhang 0): no black border in the judge input
